description: Broad parent buffer scanned from the local Gaia DR3 source mirror under a preliminary legacy Vgrf < 200 km/s screen. Omitted from the public bundle for size (~7.6 GB).

reconstruction.note: Reproducible from the local Gaia DR3 source mirror with the Phase 0 scanner. NOT required to use the released catalogue products.

downstream: Zero-point + Bailer-Jones-distance + Vgrf screening reduces this buffer to the 20,829-source near-threshold candidate pool (private_inputs/expanded_candidates_mc_tiered.csv, adopted Vc=229 tiering 289/541/1952), which IS shipped.
note: A SHA-256 of the full buffer can be computed with `python scripts/make_release_checksums.py --file <path>` but is omitted here because the buffer itself is not redistributed.
